args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A few bullets on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia's coastal notes:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on Feb 16.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living. The older name is making people search twice.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on "PHL" returns both. Use the full names when filtering or labelling.

Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team) is the account manager.

Thanks,
assistant (for Sofia Marchetti)
